subject: gk
question: The main objective of which of the following schemes is to support sustainable production in the agriculture sector by providing financial assistance to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) was launched by the Government of India in 2016 to support sustainable agriculture production by providing financial assistance to farmers.

• Its primary objective is to provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

• The scheme aims to stabilize the income of farmers to ensure their continuance in farming, thereby promoting food security, crop diversification, and enhancing growth and competitiveness of the agriculture sector.

• Under this scheme, farmers pay a very nominal premium, and the government bears the remaining financial burden.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)**

• It is a scheme that promotes organic farming methods and aims to improve soil health and organic content of the soil.

• It encourages farmers to use traditional methods of farming and reduce dependence on chemical fertilizers and pesticides.

• The scheme also aims to increase domestic production and consumption of organic produce.

• **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)**

• Launched in 2015, this scheme aims to improve on-farm water use efficiency through micro-irrigation and ensure access to irrigation to every farm ("Har Khet Ko Pani").

• PMKSY focuses on creating new water sources, repairing and restoring traditional water bodies, and promoting efficient water use technologies.

• **Gramin Bhandaran Yojana**

• This scheme aims to create scientific storage capacity for storing farm produce, processed farm produce, and agricultural inputs.

• It helps in reducing post-harvest storage losses and provides farmers with better storage facilities to store their produce until they get remunerative prices.
